applicability.scope: Source-derived Hopper SM90/SM90a kernel reasoning for TMA/mbarrier, WGMMA, resource/layout/pipeline/software scheduling and selected FP8 GEMM. CUDA categorization does not certify other GPU architectures, library dispatch, or a combined tested stack.
applicability.input_contract: Device/compute capability, compiler target and selected implementation, kernel/library revisions, shapes/strides/alignment, numeric and grouping/epilogue semantics, correctness criterion and measurement boundary.
applicability.produced_artifact: A source-qualified, reviewable hypothesis with one bounded change, resource/accuracy exchange, counter-signal, stop condition and next verification step.
applicability.failure_modes: SM90 tags or import/dispatch guards can hide an unbuilt or unselected SM90a instruction path; extra stages or register caps can increase spills or lower residency.

limitations: Native compilation, GPU correctness, numerical accuracy, profiling, performance, model/service behavior and skill efficacy were not run.
KernelWiki is Blackwell-first; frontmatter tags, verified labels and snippet claims are not Hopper compatibility proofs.
Only selected code sections and nine source summary bodies were mined; remaining source headers and synthesis dispositions are explicit in the inventory.
Source numerical claims, fixed tuning defaults and unsafe teaching snippets are not imported as local evidence or recipes.
Pinned KernelWiki has no root LICENSE; KDA MIT assertion and its sanitized-distribution discrepancy are retained, with third-party terms kept separate.
recommendations: For WGMMA advice, confirm the compiled and selected SM90a path; do not transplant Blackwell-only instruction or memory mechanisms.
Resolve producer/consumer ownership and completion before tuning stage depth; budget live accumulators, padded shared memory, scales and epilogue storage together.
For later validation, check tails, short K, stage wraparound and grouped offsets against the frozen reference, inspect actual PTX/SASS resources, and include setup/conversion/reduction costs.
